errors: The nginx snippet is shown without any mention that preflight OPTIONS handling needs additional config (return 204 plus Allow-Methods/Headers), so it will not fully work for preflighted requests.
Redirect point is vague: a redirect can fail a preflight, but a simple cross-origin redirect does not itself cause this error.
Spring `@CrossOrigin` and the Django note omit the credentials caveat, which is a minor omission rather than an error.
